Team Camber Racing: Formula Student

Context & Linkage: SRM Spectrum (Volume 19 Number 2) names student leaders from these three departments. No other departments are named.

Documented Facts & Primary Sources

Every statement below is recorded directly from the cited source. Figures and claims are as published by SRM or third-party reports.

Named National Champion at Formula Bharat 2026, with first place in Endurance, Skidpad, Autocross, Acceleration, Engineering Design, Fuel Economy, and Sustainability & Best Practices.

Sourced from official SRM publication [C2] SRM Spectrum, Volume 19 Number 2 (2026), page 2: Team Camber Racing claims national title at Formula Bharat 2026 ↗ Captured on 2026-10-30
Source note: Names individual student leaders; this site records departments only.

Evo India reports that the team won the Combustion category at Formula Bharat 2026.

Sourced from news [C1] Formula Bharat 2026 news, Evo India ↗ Captured on 2026-10-28
Source note: Reports the Combustion category result.

Student leaders named by SRM come from Electronics and Communication Engineering (captain), Mechatronics Engineering (vice captain) and Automobile Engineering (technical director, project manager, chief race driver).

Sourced from official SRM publication [C2] SRM Spectrum, Volume 19 Number 2 (2026), page 2: Team Camber Racing claims national title at Formula Bharat 2026 ↗ Captured on 2026-10-30
Source note: Names individual student leaders; this site records departments only.

The Formula Student combustion team sits within the Department of Automobile Engineering.

Sourced from official SRM publication [C4] SRM Spectrum, Volume 19 Number 1, page 12: Team Camber Racing at SUPRA SAEINDIA 2025 ↗ Captured on 2026-10-30
Source note: Describes the team as the Formula Student combustion team from the Department of Automobile Engineering.

Formula Student Germany describes the team as undergraduates from a range of engineering disciplines.

Sourced from third-party page [C3] Formula Student Germany team page for Camber Racing ↗ Captured on 2026-10-28
Source note: Team description only.
